question: Across the 223,261 nested draws of the short-description code: the share by weight and among distinct sampled families whose least ray bond grows, is bounded or is absent, by fate.

definitions.classes: settled S1-S4; computed grows / bounded / mixed by residue / lost at large depths / none at any depth / unresolved, as in the spec

public_inputs.code: written by Codex in codex/ from the spec; LIMIT-ONLY sample rows, dlang.py, BD census.py, PR codex code and the PROVED-RATE referee's recompute.py read-only.
public_inputs.run: codex exec with the spec in one memory-capped unit; the full run launched by the thread from Codex's runner.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the spec, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: class per distinct family, joined to draws: weight shares with two-sided bands per cell.
cheapest_meaningful_control: PR's and BOND-DEPTH's records on the 664 one-definition families (G1) and an independent brute force (G3).
validation_gate: G0-G3 of the pre-registration; any failure invalidates the run.

predictions.P1: bounded typical (lower end > 1/2) among computed forever draws with a persisting ray bond
predictions.P2: grows in [5%, 24%] among computed forever draws
predictions.P3: limit-only minus forever grows share >= 10 points, bootstrap 2.5% quantile > 0

stop_rule: One Codex hand-off, one full run by the thread, its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
